sanskrit: aśaṃ te śvaśrūr vadatu śvaśuras te aśantaram | devā te abhiśocanaṃ brahma vidveṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ||
english: May your mother-in-law speak ill of you, may your father-in-law speak worse of you; the gods have made the brahman-spell against you a cause of anguish, of estrangement.

sanskrit: ā krandayolulā kuru vācam ā dhehy apriyām | śiro lipsasva hastābhyāṃ keśās te abhiśocanam ||
english: Howl and wail, utter disagreeable speech; grasp your head with both hands — your hair shall be your anguish.

sanskrit: ye keśā yau pratidhī yat kurīraṃ ya opaśaḥ | atho ye te svāḥ santi sarve te te 'bhiśocanam ||
english: These tresses, those two hair-bands, that head-ornament, that tuft of hair — and whatever belongings are yours: all these shall be your anguish.

sanskrit: apa trasa paridhānād unmādanaṃ kṛṇomi te | atho yat te svaṃ vāsaḥ sarvaṃ tat te 'bhiśocanam ||
english: Shrink away from your garment — I make a maddening spell for you; and whatever garment is your own, all that shall be your anguish.

sanskrit: arkam addhi pra patāto municakṣuṃ kṛṇomi te | atho śvabhyo rāyadbhyaṃ prati sma gaṅgaṇaṃ kuru ||
english: Eat the arka-plant, take flight — I make your eyes wild as a sage's; and toward the barking dogs keep making your whimpering sound.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhāre palāyasva marīcīnāṃ padaṃ bhava | atho yat kāryaṃ kurv āśāṃ sam ṛṣa muṣkayoḥ ||
english: Rise up, run away, become the abode of mirages; and in doing your business, press together the two testicles in longing.

sanskrit: upa kṣvedābhi cālaya vātaś tūlam ivaijaya | dadbhiḥ saṃdaśya bāhvor udaddhi muravasthiye ||
english: Hiss at him and agitate him; drive him as the wind drives a tuft of cotton; biting with teeth upon the arms, lift up the braid-fastened one.

sanskrit: abhi gāya śābaleyaṃ śauṇeyaṃ sādhuvāhinam | kālmāṣeyasya carkṛdhy āyataḥ prati cālaya ||
english: Sing toward the spotted one, the yellow one, the well-pulling dog; keep stirring and agitating the dappled one as it comes.

sanskrit: ṛśyapucchaṃ śunaḥpucchaṃ vātaraṃhaṃ manojavam | taṃ te rathaṃ saṃ bharantu devās tenā carāsi patim icchamānā ||
english: Swift as the wind, swift as the mind — that chariot with the tail of the spotted antelope and the tail of the dog: may the gods harness it for you; riding it, seek your husband.

sanskrit: agnaye sam anaman tasmai pṛthivyā sam anaman | yathāgnaye pṛthivyā samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu | vittiṃ bhūtiṃ puṣṭiṃ paśūn brahma brāhmaṇavarcasam | saṃnataya stha saṃ me namata svāhā ||
english: They bowed together to Agni; to him they bowed together through the earth. Just as they bowed together to Agni through the earth, so may all bow together to me. Acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman — O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: vāyave sam anaman tasmā antarikṣeṇa sam anaman | yathā vāyave antarikṣeṇa samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Vāyu; to him they bowed together through the atmosphere. Just as they bowed together to Vāyu through the atmosphere, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: sūryāya sam anaman tasmai divā sam anaman | yathā sūryāya divā samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Sūrya; to him they bowed together through the sky. Just as they bowed together to Sūrya through the sky, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: candrāya sam anaman tasmai nakṣatraiḥ sam anaman | yathā candrāya nakṣatraiḥ samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Candra; to him they bowed together through the asterisms. Just as they bowed together to Candra through the asterisms, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: somāya sam anaman tasmā oṣadhībhiḥ sam anaman | yathā somāyauṣadhībhiḥ samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Soma; to him they bowed together through the plants. Just as they bowed together to Soma through the plants, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: yajñāya sam anaman tasmai dakṣiṇābhiḥ sam anaman | yathā yajñāya dakṣiṇābhiḥ samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to the sacrifice; to it they bowed together through the sacrificial fees. Just as they bowed together to the sacrifice through the sacrificial fees, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: samudrāya sam anaman tasmai nadībhiḥ sam anaman | yathā samudrāya nadībhiḥ samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to the ocean; to it they bowed together through the rivers. Just as they bowed together to the ocean through the rivers, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: brahmaṇe sam anaman tasmai brahmacāribhiḥ sam anaman | yathā brahmaṇe brahmacāribhiḥ samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Brahman; to it they bowed together through the student-ascetics. Just as they bowed together to Brahman through the student-ascetics, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: indrāya sam anaman tasmai vīryeṇa sam anaman | yathendrāya vīryeṇa samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to Indra; to him they bowed together through heroic might. Just as they bowed together to Indra through heroic might, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: devebhyaḥ sam anaman tebhyo 'mṛtena sam anaman | yathā devebhyo 'mṛtena samanaman (…) ||
english: They bowed together to the gods; to them they bowed together through immortality. Just as they bowed together to the gods through immortality, even so may all bow together to me — [acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman; O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!]

sanskrit: prajāpataye sam anaman tasmai prajābhiḥ sam anaman | yathā prajāpataye prajābhiḥ samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu | vittiṃ bhūtiṃ puṣṭiṃ paśūn brahma brāhmaṇavarcasam | saṃnataya stha saṃ me namata svāhā ||
english: They bowed together to Prajāpati; to him they bowed together through his creatures. Just as they bowed together to Prajāpati through his creatures, even so may all bow together to me. Acquisition, prosperity, nourishment, cattle, sacred knowledge, and the lustre of a brahman — O bow-makings, you are here; bow together to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: sapta saṃnamo 'ṣṭamī dhītisādhanī | sakāmān adhvanaḥ kṛṇu saṃjñānam astu vo dhane ||
english: Seven are the bow-makings; the eighth is the accomplisher of insight. Make the paths favorable to those who desire; may there be mutual understanding among you in the matter of wealth.

sanskrit: ye vāruṇā uta nairṛtā vanaspatīnāṃ vīrudhāṃ ca pāśāḥ | ye bhaumā bhūmyā adhi saṃbabhūvus te tvā na hiṃsāñ chivatātir astu te ||
english: The fetters belonging to Varuṇa and those belonging to Nirṛti, the fetters of trees and of plants, those earthly ones that have arisen from the earth — may they not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: ye antarikṣe divi ye ca pāśā anne vicṛttā bahudhā sinanti | ye paśubhyo adhi saṃbabhūvus te tvā na hiṃsāñ chivatātir astu te ||
english: The fetters that are in the atmosphere, those that are in the sky, those scattered throughout food that bind in manifold ways, those that have arisen from among cattle — may they not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: yaṃ mānuṣaṃ manuṣyāḥ śapante yāṃ vā hotrāṃ pitryām ārabhante | samāmyo varuṇo ya ājagāma sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: The human bond with which men curse, or the priestly rite of the fathers which one undertakes — Varuṇa who comes as the proximate one, may he not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: apaḥ pragāhya yadi vā samāmiṣe agnim ārebhiṣe yadi vā samiddham | vidvān avidvān anṛtaṃ yad uvaktha tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: Whether you plunged into the waters with intent, or whether you laid hold of the fire when it was blazing — whatever falsehood you spoke, knowing or unknowing, may that not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: yat pratīcyāṃ dṛṣatpiṣṭām̐ āmapeṣām̐ āmapātre papātha | hīnaḥ satyenānṛtaṃ yad uvaktha tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: What was ground on a stone in the western direction, what raw grains and raw oblation you drank from a raw vessel — bereft of truth, whatever falsehood you spoke, may that not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: yaṃ bāṇavantaṃ sudihaṃ saṃbharanti yaṃ vā hastaṃ brāhmaṇasyārabhante | samāmyo varuṇo yaṃ jaghāna tasya śmaśānād adhi loṣṭa ābhṛtaḥ sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: The one they equip with arrows and well-plastered with clay, or the hand of the brahman that one lays hold of — Varuṇa who is proximate, whom he struck down: the clod brought from his cremation-ground, may that not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: yaṃ grāvāṇam ārabhante yenāṃśūn abhiṣuṇvanti somam | yad vā dhanaṃ dhanakāmo niremiṣe kṣetraṃ gām aśvaṃ puruṣaṃ vobhayādat tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: The pressing-stone they lay hold of, with which they press the soma shoots — or the wealth you coveted and took away, the field, the cow, the horse, the person, or both together: may that not harm you; may welfare be yours.

sanskrit: apaḥ pragāhya yadi vā vyāmiṣe agnim ārebhiṣe yadi vā samiddham | jāmyā hastaṃ kṛtam ārebhiṣe dhanur vottatam iti cakramitha | manyau vā rājño varuṇasyāsi saktaḥ sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te ||
english: Whether you plunged into the waters with hostile intent, or laid hold of the blazing fire, or took hold of the hand of a female kinsman as was done, or strung the bow — or whether you are caught in the wrath of King Varuṇa: may he not harm you; may welfare be yours.
